Question 4
?

In degrees, what is the general solution to the equation sin⁡x=−12? Assume that n is an integer.

a
x=210∘+n⋅360∘,x=330∘+n⋅360∘
b
x=30∘+n⋅360∘,x=210∘+n⋅360∘
c
x=225∘+n⋅360∘,x=315∘+n⋅360∘
d
x=60∘+n⋅360∘,x=120∘+n⋅360∘
e
x=120∘+n⋅360∘,x=240∘+n⋅360∘
Submit
